metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.current_adjudication_basis: Current Quidra uses indentation blocks without braces/semicolons, local auto inference and concise range/collection forms while keeping typed boundaries and explicit error/resource semantics; generic/class/error handling retains deliberate bounded ceremony.
metric.code_efficiency_conciseness.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.concurrency.current_adjudication_basis: Current Quidra provides bounded structured task.all execution, ordered scalar result transfer, atomic.Counter shared state and explicit GPU asynchronous execution/synchronization; general cancellation, channels/actors and broad synchronization remain limited.
metric.concurrency.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.dependency_simplicity.current_adjudication_basis: Current import/package semantics distinguish quoted local imports from installed packages, reject cycles, control re-exports, resolve exact stable release tags and lock transitive content hashes, making visibility and resolution explicit.
metric.dependency_simplicity.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.diagnostics.current_adjudication_basis: Current Quidra diagnostics have stable codes, source spans, structured JSON output, cause-specific messages, bounded recovery and coded runtime failures, directly covering the five frozen diagnostic components.
metric.diagnostics.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.ffi_interoperability_design.current_adjudication_basis: Current Quidra documents explicit extern C declarations, FFI-specific diagnostics, a restricted ABI-safe scalar/string/bin/callback subset, reference restrictions and symbol-conflict checks; aggregate layout coverage and broader ABI/callback surface remain intentionally limited.
metric.ffi_interoperability_design.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.functionality_expressiveness.current_adjudication_basis: Current docs specify classes, constrained generics, tagged unions, exhaustive match, first-class function values, arbitrary-precision numerics, arrays/tensors, explicit errors, FFI, modules/packages and native/runtime control; dynamic abstraction remains intentionally narrower than the richest peers.
metric.functionality_expressiveness.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.portability_design_platform_neutr.current_adjudication_basis: Current architecture keeps semantics in the frontend and typed IR, treats LLVM as an implementation target, specifies numeric/storage semantics independently of host details and centralizes platform declarations; platform abstraction/conditional mechanisms remain less complete than the strongest mature multi-target designs.
metric.portability_design_platform_neutr.limitations: Current Quidra judgments are valid only for the exact compiler/runtime plus docs/tests identities frozen in this snapshot; relevant target changes must miss.

metric.readability.current_adjudication_basis: Current Quidra makes types, writable aliases (&), control flow and error propagation explicit with low punctuation noise and regular forms; a few language-specific spellings and rules still require familiarity.

unresolved_units.reason: The preserved certified cache contains only the legacy numeric scores plus a note pointing to evidence.md; retained workspace evidence does not contain that promised evidence.md or another recoverable metric rationale.
